This is one bounded correction, introduces no abstraction, and adds no module, class, or interface.

approach-extend-npm-installation.reason: Disabling npm-installation leaves no installation directory, so later checks fail for unrelated reasons and the missing-override control cannot prove that npm ls alone catches its plant.

forces: The kit and own-service npm installations must be judged by one npm ls assertion, so they cannot drift apart.
approach-duplicate-npm-ls-assertion.reason: Two implementations can diverge in npm arguments, status handling, or failure text, leaving the kit and own-service installation judgments inconsistent despite the same intended rule.

forces: The kit's contents and the packed packages must not change.
approach-change-packed-node-dependency.reason: Changing the packed dependency violates the existing requirement that building the kit not change the packed contents of the three packages and expands #769 beyond detection.

forces: The kit gate must fail when the kit's npm installation resolves the core through anything but the kit's own pin.
approach-runtime-one-copy-probe.reason: Without overrides npm links the binding file dependency to the top-level core, so one core copy loads and the runtime probe passes while npm ls reports the tree invalid.

evidence_ids: Task 2.2 adds npm-dependency-tree immediately after npm-installation in both gate modes.
Node validation in task 3.1 exercises the kit gate and reports its check clause.
Task 2.3 adds one measured missing-override plant that fails at npm-dependency-tree.
The task 3.3 sweep records the control failing when its named check is disabled because the whole gate then passes.
Task 2.1 routes the existing own-service npm assertion through the shared helper under the same label.
Node validation in task 3.1 retains the own-service installer controls and their byte-identical failure assertion.

security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, checksum, kit identity, or integrity assertion changes; the work only adds a local verification check for npm's dependency report.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication, authorization, principal, permission, or access-control behavior changes; the scripts install disposable local evaluation artifacts only.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, approval record, signature, provenance field, or release authorization changes; the gate records only local verification results.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction adds one awaited npm command to existing sequential gate execution and introduces no scheduler, lock, shared state, or concurrent coordination.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret, credential, personal data, or confidential payload handling changes; npm diagnostics describe only disposable local package dependencies.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, digest computation, key handling, signing, or verification behavior changes; existing kit digests and identity format remain unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The helper preserves the established bounded npm failure surface and adds no external diagnostic channel, credential output, or new disclosure of kit content.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, network service, exporter, collector deployment, or third-party security integration is introduced or changed.
security_justification.fail_posture: The change strengthens an existing fail-closed verification gate by rejecting npm's invalid dependency tree while preserving the existing package and kit behavior.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, sink, operation, package, or release lifecycle transition changes; the added check runs only during disposable evaluation-kit verification.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The planted control rewrites only a copied disposable kit manifest through the existing measured and resealed control path; it does not mutate source artifacts.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transformation, data classification, redaction, prohibited-data scan, or personal-data processing behavior changes.
security_justification.resource_retention: No storage or retention policy changes; temporary installation directories and copied kits retain the existing cleanup and disposable lifetime.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queueing, or attempt behavior changes; npm ls is one additional deterministic gate assertion after installation.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Repository, local temporary-directory, and evaluator trust boundaries remain unchanged; no new principal, external system, or trust crossing is introduced.
